In summary, our research is concerned with

the structural characterization of poly-lactic acid (poly-l-lactic acid, PLLA) and poly(glicolic acid) (PGA), which are the two main polymers used in the production of biodegradable and biocompatible materials, such as sutures and drug carriers.
the study of oligomer structures of two biodegradable polymers (PLLA and PGA), with a focus on their diffusion in water.
the structural characterization of oligomers of l-lactic and glycolic acids, in order to understand their behaviour in water.

the oligomers have been optimized with DFT calculations and the rotational barriers have been investigated.
